title: 2007 Firestone–West paper on the Younger Dryas impact
summary: Randall Carlson tells of 2007 Firestone–West paper on the Younger Dryas impact, about 2007 at unspecified, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, then in 2007, Richard Firestone and Allan West and a number of others came out with a paper. George Howard came out with a paper proposing exactly that.

plain: Randall Carlson, a researcher of ancient catastrophes, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 2007 scientists Richard Firestone, Allan West and others, along with George Howard, put out a paper on the Younger Dryas, a sudden cold spell near the end of the last ice age. Carlson says the paper proposed exactly what he had been arguing: that a cosmic impact caused it. If true, it would mean a disaster from space reshaped the world early humans lived in.
